experimental_design: Samples were analyzed in a randomized block design and run in technical triplicates.
number_of_biological_replicates: For metaproteomics analysis, we used three biological replicates per tissue (trophosome, vestimentum, and plume) and condition (specimens with S-rich and S-depleted trophosomes), which resulted in a total of 18 samples.
number_of_samples: For metaproteomics analysis, we used three biological replicates per tissue (trophosome, vestimentum, and plume) and condition (specimens with S-rich and S-depleted trophosomes), which resulted in a total of 18 samples.
number_of_technical_replicates: Samples were analyzed in a randomized block design and run in technical triplicates.
technology_type: The tryptic digest was desalted on-line during liquid chromatography tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) analysis.
